newsitem.title: USA: USDA proposes expansion of Soybean Board.
newsitem.headline: USDA proposes expansion of Soybean Board.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Wednesday it wanted to increase from 59 to 62 the number of members on the United Soybean Board to reflect changes in state soybean production during the past two years.
In a notice published in the Federal Register, the agency's Agricultural Marketing Service said it would accept comments from the public on the proposal until May 30.

Some 381,000 U.S. soybean producers who pay assessments to the program that promotes domestic soybean sales and exports. The agency's proposal would increase the number of representatives on the board from Indiana, Minnesota and the Dakotas, and reduce Virginia's representation.
